intro.text: Tradewinds Universal, Inc. (the “Company”) was incorporated in the State of Wyoming on December 28, 2021. The Company operates as a holding company focused on acquiring, developing, and managing businesses with long-term value, resilience, and growth potential. The Company’s initial operations focused on the development and distribution of high-nutrition foods and beverages, including edible insect protein-based products. In 2022, the Company acquired a canine pain relief formula for development into pet-related products. During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company expanded its strategic focus to include distribution and licensing activities.
